task: ByteVerse homepage redesign, copy rewrite and technical SEO
status: Implemented and validated locally; not committed, pushed or deployed

scope.validationData: Fictional article fixtures in a disposable credential-free production build; no production database or provider mutations

research.method: Public Google autocomplete, three actual Google SERPs, competitor homepage review, official SEO/performance docs and local source audit

serps.observation: Mixed utility directories, development platforms and informational lists; Coddy, Free-for.dev, Figma, Browserling and DevToolLab appeared. Task-first utility discovery fits better than a generic AI blog pitch.
Established suites including Ahrefs, Moz and SEOptimer. ByteVerse should not imply equivalent backlink, rank-tracking or comprehensive site-audit capabilities.
ByteVerse.fyi appeared first in this branded session; unrelated ByteVerse entities also appeared. This is not general keyword rank tracking.

competitorsReviewed.learning: Direct searchable task discovery rather than long promotional sections.
Clear utility proposition; its native-app offline promise and testimonials cannot be transferred to ByteVerse.
Categorized utility links help users choose a task quickly; no copied copy or trust logos.

research.frameworkDocs: Installed Next.js 16.2.6 documentation for metadata, JSON-LD, ISR and responsive/lazy images

intentDecision.homepage: Free developer tools plus practical tech guides: a balanced task-first gateway
intentDecision.toolPages: Specific image compressor, JSON converter, title checker and other utility queries stay on their canonical tool pages
intentDecision.discardedSuggestions: Browser DevTools/extensions, physical free tools, Illustrator meanings of AI, unrelated ByteVerse login/hackathon/company queries
intentDecision.title: Free Developer Tools & Practical Tech Guides | ByteVerse
intentDecision.description: Free online developer tools for JSON, images, SEO and everyday tasks. Explore practical coding tutorials, AI explainers and tech guides on ByteVerse.

implementation: Server-rendered hero, catalog-derived curated utility cards, globally latest articles, topic discovery, native FAQ disclosures and a small newsletter client island
Responsive CSS Module with light/dark themes, logical properties, RTL wrapping, contrast-safe colors and reduced-motion support
Tool count derived from the real 42-entry catalog; no invented guide count, popularity ranking, unlimited-use or universal client-side/testing promises
Ten homepage DB queries reduced to one compact left join for six globally newest published, due posts; no article bodies selected; deterministic createdAt/id ordering
Absent DB returns an honest empty feed; query errors propagate with sanitized messages so ISR retains the last successful page instead of caching an empty result
Absolute homepage title, canonical, OG/Twitter metadata and coherent 1200x630 social image
Escaped Organization/WebSite/WebPage JSON-LD with stable entity IDs; removed nonfunctional SearchAction and homepage FAQPage markup
Removed delayed hero animation and lazy code demo; all below-fold article covers lazy with responsive sizes and reserved aspect ratios; no cover preloads
Translation loads only after a language selection or saved non-English choice; English restoration and RTL behavior retained
Keyboard skip link/main target; dense homepage and header navigation avoids speculative route prefetch; image-tool full-document boundary preserved
Newsletter label/live status, bounded JSON request, honeypot, honest API success contract and no-JavaScript disabled form with POST fallback to avoid email-in-URL leaks
Removed stale fixed homepage sitemap lastModified only; no fabricated fresh dates across other routes
System monospace for the illustrative code sample avoids loading a second webfont on the homepage

browserCoverage: Axe WCAG A/AA checks with no violations in audited states
Keyboard skip link, mobile menu and native FAQ
Mocked opt-in translation, saved preference, RTL and English restore
validation.build: PASS: isolated Next.js production build and TypeScript, 104 generated pages, homepage 6h ISR
validation.actualSourceTypecheck: PASS: tsc --noEmit --incremental false (including actual compact DB query module)
validation.lint: PASS: changed TS/TSX and homepage helper scripts
validation.visualReview: Actual Edge screenshots reviewed at desktop and mobile in light/dark; fixtures are explicitly fictional, not newly published articles

unchangedDraftContentSha256.normalization: UTF-8, CRLF/CR converted to LF, trim; same convention as existing draft ledgers

mobileLab.interpretation: Same fixture host before/after, but substantial machine/timing variation. Local HTML decreased about 39%; initial translation requests fell to zero. Do not attribute the full TBT difference to code or compare production score 52 directly with a credential-free local score. Final performance is not 100 and field CWV is unverified.
remainingMeasuredCosts: Approximately 232 KB decoded shared global stylesheet
